requirements.statement: One client-only package owns the complete cross-shell and client-world display, video, audio and presentation-accessibility settings catalog.
acceptance: Shell and client-world locks select the same client-presentation setting IDs and persisted effective values while headless omits the package without authoritative differences.
Display previews recover from timeout or unsupported modes; audio and video values expose requested, admitted and effective states with provider diagnostics.
The baseline catalog covers required Accessibility, Audio and Video groups, and optional providers contribute namespaced feature-conditional rows through the shared registry and selected surface.
